title: Geopolitics of West Asian Maritime Corridors & India's Trade Interests
prelims_pointers: India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC) aims to enhance trade connectivity across Eurasia.
Chabahar Port provides strategic sea-land access to Central Asian markets bypassing regional bottlenecks.

mains_perspective.context: Navigating complex multilateral alignments amidst regional conflicts in West Asia.
mains_perspective.key_arguments: Securing energy supply chains, safeguarding Indian diaspora interests, and balancing multi-alignment strategies.
mains_perspective.way_forward: Strengthen bilateral security frameworks and operationalize regional maritime safety initiatives.

title: UNCLOS & Maritime Domain Security in the Indo-Pacific Region
prelims_pointers: UNCLOS defines Exclusive Economic Zones (EEZ) extending up to 200 nautical miles from baseline.
SAGAR (Security and Growth for All in the Region) represents India's maritime doctrine.

mains_perspective.context: Ensuring freedom of navigation and rules-based international maritime order.
mains_perspective.key_arguments: Addressing non-traditional security threats including illegal fishing, piracy, and sea lane disruptions.
mains_perspective.way_forward: Deepen Quad maritime domain awareness and enhance joint naval patrol protocols.

title: Preservation of Coastal Fortresses & Maratha Heritage Architecture
prelims_pointers: Maratha Military Landscapes were nominated for UNESCO World Heritage site recognition.
Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) acts as statutory custodian under AMASR Act 1958.

mains_perspective.context: Strategic conservation of 17th-century coastal, sea, and hill fort structures across Maharashtra.
mains_perspective.key_arguments: Promoting sustainable eco-tourism while preventing structural degradation from coastal weathering.
mains_perspective.way_forward: Adopt scientific stone preservation methods and community-led heritage management.

title: Digital Public Infrastructure & Sovereign AI Compute Stack Integration
prelims_pointers: India Stack includes open API layers like UPI, Aadhaar, and DigiLocker.
MeitY leads the IndiaAI Mission to build GPU-compute infrastructure for domestic AI models.

mains_perspective.context: Scaling DPI beyond financial technologies into healthcare diagnostics and precision agriculture.
mains_perspective.key_arguments: Reduces dependency on global tech monopolies while securing national data sovereignty.
mains_perspective.way_forward: Establish robust data privacy audits and expand high-speed optical fiber into rural panchayats.

title: Ethical Frameworks, Integrity & Whistleblower Protection in Administration
prelims_pointers: Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) functions as an independent statutory vigilance body.
2nd Administrative Reforms Commission (ARC) Report 4 focuses specifically on Ethics in Governance.

mains_perspective.context: Reinforcing institutional accountability, integrity, and transparency in public service delivery.
mains_perspective.key_arguments: Preventing administrative discretionary abuse and protecting honest civil service officers.
mains_perspective.way_forward: Implement mandatory e-procurement portals, proactive RTI disclosures, and value-based civil services training.
